patch.value: Refuse closeout when required-check metadata is unverified
Fix https://github.com/unbraind/pm-github/issues/138. Require complete protection metadata or explicit caller-declared contexts; harden caller permissions.
Unavailable metadata without declarations never closes or publishes; declared contexts require success; metadata-backed behavior remains unchanged; npm and Bun release gates pass.

value.text: Plan: distinguish unavailable protection metadata from a readable empty policy. Exercise real command and workflow shell against injected HTTP evidence and real trackers. Keep workflow edits minimal around open PR #139.
